instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React component to display the car images sequence.
Implement 4 buttons: Front, Right, Back, Left.
Map these buttons to indices: Front(0), Right(2), Back(4), Left(6).
Preload all 8 images on mount using a standard `new Image().src = ...` approach to prevent flickering.
Use framer-motion `useSpring` or a `requestAnimationFrame` loop with lerping to smoothly interpolate a `currentFrame` floating point value to the `targetFrame` integer value.

Calculate the shortest path on the circular sequence. E.g., if you are at 0 (Front) and click Left (index 6), the shortest path is to subtract 2, so the target becomes -2. Round the interpolated value to get the current frame index, and use `((roundedValue % 8) + 8) % 8` to get the actual array index for the image.
Do NOT rotate a single image using CSS transform. You must update the `src` of an `` tag based on the current sequence index.
Create a clean minimalist layout with a white background. No bulky cards, no unnecessary text. The car and the angle buttons are the hero.
